beats.event: Wealthy Pashtun boy in Kabul, flies kites with servant Hassan
Bully Assef threatens Amir; Hassan defends him with a slingshot
Amir wins the neighborhood kite tournament
Watches Assef rape Hassan in the alley and does not intervene
Frames Hassan for theft to drive him from the household
1979 Soviet invasion: Amir and Baba flee to California
Marries Soraya; becomes a published novelist
Dying Rahim Khan calls: 'a way to be good again'
Learns Hassan was his half-brother, murdered by the Taliban
Travels to Kabul to rescue Hassan's son Sohrab
Discovers Assef holds Sohrab; is beaten with brass knuckles
Sohrab shoots out Assef's eye with slingshot; they escape
Sohrab attempts suicide during immigration delays
Returns to America; Sohrab remains withdrawn
Kite fight in America; Sohrab finally smiles
